correctness.rationale: A bijection for partitions containing a fixed adjacent arc yields an exact increment h_i in nesting-minus-crossing pair count. Equidistribution removes the unmarked term; summing h_i gives the nonnegative dimension statistic. The aggregate dimension identity is independently proved by cut double-counting and Bell recurrence. Strict positivity is witnessed by block {1,3}; Bell-ratio asymptotics show linear growth. Finite exact verification passed 13,141 checks but does not replace the proof.

originality.rationale: Literature and database searches identified the exact prior dimension aggregate and pair-count marginal equidistribution, but not the claimed difference of mixed covariances. Those prior claims do not logically determine dependence on levels; the new marked-contraction identity supplies the missing step. Coverage by implicit results in more general crossing/nesting enumerators remains a stated historical-priority risk.
residual_risks: A more general unpublished or older enumerative identity may determine the same mixed moments implicitly.
Broad historical textbooks and restricted statistics tables were not exhaustively inspected; absence in a search cannot establish uniqueness.
The reference equidistribution of pair counts is used; it is not claimed that maximal crossing and nesting sizes are the same variables.

value.rationale: This motivated mixed statistic distinguishes two equidistributed pair counts in a canonical probability space.
